from datetime import date, datetime, time, timedelta, timezone
from io import BytesIO
import unittest

import tomli


class TestOptionalSeconds(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_local_time_without_seconds(self):
        for literal, expected in (
            ("00:00", time(0, 0)),
            ("07:32", time(7, 32)),
            ("23:59", time(23, 59)),
        ):
            with self.subTest(literal=literal):
                self.assertEqual(tomli.loads("v = " + literal), {"v": expected})

    def test_datetime_without_seconds(self):
        for literal, expected in (
            ("0001-01-01T00:00", datetime(1, 1, 1)),
            ("9999-12-31t23:59", datetime(9999, 12, 31, 23, 59)),
            ("2024-02-29 07:32Z", datetime(2024, 2, 29, 7, 32, tzinfo=timezone.utc)),
            ("2024-02-29t07:32z", datetime(2024, 2, 29, 7, 32, tzinfo=timezone.utc)),
            ("1979-05-27T07:32+05:30", datetime(1979, 5, 27, 7, 32, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30)))),
            ("1979-05-27 07:32-07:00", datetime(1979, 5, 27, 7, 32, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=-7)))),
        ):
            with self.subTest(literal=literal):
                self.assertEqual(tomli.loads("v = " + literal), {"v": expected})

    def test_containers_comments_and_binary_load(self):
        document = b"v = [00:00, 23:59]\nx = { dt = 2024-02-29T07:32Z } # comment\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            tomli.load(BytesIO(document)),
            {"v": [time(0, 0), time(23, 59)], "x": {"dt": datetime(2024, 2, 29, 7, 32, tzinfo=timezone.utc)}},
        )

    def test_seconds_and_date_preserved(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            tomli.loads("v = [07:32:45.123456789, 2024-02-29T07:32:45.5Z, 2024-02-29]"),
            {"v": [time(7, 32, 45, 123456), datetime(2024, 2, 29, 7, 32, 45, 500000, tzinfo=timezone.utc), date(2024, 2, 29)]},
        )

    def test_invalid_time_components(self):
        for literal in (
            "24:00", "23:60", "7:32", "07:3", "07", "07:32:",
            "07:32:5", "07:32:60", "07:32.5", "07:32Z",
            "2023-02-29T07:32", "2024-02-29T24:00",
            "2024-02-29T07:60", "2024-02-29T07:32.5Z",
            "2024-02-29T07:32+24:00", "2024-02-29T07:32+05:60",
            "2024-02-29T07:32+05", "07:32junk",
        ):
            with self.subTest(literal=literal):
                with self.assertRaises(tomli.TOMLDecodeError):
                    tomli.loads("v = " + literal)
